outcome: Narrowest parameters of the bony birth canal (position and diameter)
Measurement accuracy of the 3D CT method
Processing speed of the 3D CT method
Estimated risk of complications during childbirth
cohort: The study included 31 female patients with hip dysplasia who underwent unilateral Periacetabular osteotomy (PAO) surgery, with CT data collected both pre- and post-operatively.
finding: The proposed 3D CT measurement method accurately and validly quantifies the bony birth canal, improving measurement accuracy of the narrowest position and diameter by 65% and 78% respectively, and increasing processing speed by 32% compared to a benchmark method.
mod_finding: The quantitative analysis of the bony birth canal can help doctors estimate future childbirth complication risks and determine appropriate delivery methods for patients who have undergone PAO.
